versions.content: Error to be returned when executeDespiteDataUnavailability is disabled and queue is empty Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00107, SRS_Rte_00110, SRS_Rte_00094 When executeDespiteDataUnavailability of DataTransformation is disabled and an empty queue is polled, the RTE shall return with a status RTE_E_NO_DATA to the polling function.
